R1.description: A spent checks_pending wait, or a checks_pending stop that cannot wait (no auto-merge), sends checks_wait (INFO, LOW) on the branch-gate path and the job-record path; a waitable gate whose step did not wait sends nothing (#170)

R2.description: A checks_pending stop becomes lane_blocked only when the checks have been pending over four hours; the identity, the supersedes guard and the other wait codes are unchanged (#170)

R3.description: The guides and the roadmap state the new rule; NF2 is done (#170)
